summary: Full-stack HorizonQuest E2E validated. Backend pytest: 23/23 passed. UI Playwright: Guide console (create expedition + join code + leaderboard toggle), Explorer join+territory+trial submit 100% mastery, leaderboard rank/fleet chart, Guide review approve (+25), Guide mastery chart, and Claude Copilot streaming all verified.

minor.issue: Response returns current-attempt `mastery` (can flip to false on a partial retry) while DB correctly preserves best. Consider returning `stored_mastery`/`best_score` too so UI can show cumulative status. Points are correctly non-decreasing (delta clamped >=0).

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to each shadcn Dialog to fix the console warning.

Shows '+0' Horizon Points because the best-score-only rule (correct behavior) — but the toast still says 'Mastery! +0 Horizon Points' which reads oddly. Consider suppressing the '+N' when N==0 and instead show 'Mastery preserved'.

action_items: Optional: enrich /api/trials/.../submit response with best_score/best_mastery so UI can show accurate cumulative state on repeat attempts.
Optional: add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialog usages (Members, Result, Copilot Sheet) to remove a11y console warning.
Optional: hide '+0' badge / toast when no new points are awarded on a repeat mastery.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user parses expires_at defensively for both str/datetime — good.

join_expedition assigns fleet via round-robin from count of members BEFORE the current insert, which can double-assign the same fleet index across concurrent joins; low risk for MVP but note for future.
AI Copilot uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with claude-sonnet-4-6 — streaming verified end-to-end. system prompt correctly forbids direct answers.
Curriculum grader is deterministic and matches answer keys in /app/backend/curriculum.py.
test_credentials: Seeded sessions: Guide token 'qa_guide_tok' (user qa-guide), Explorer token 'qa_exp_tok' (user qa-exp). Bearer + httpOnly cookie both supported on host explorer-journey-4.preview.emergentagent.com.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created expedition 'TEST_UI_Voyage' (join_code varies each run) via Guide UI, then Explorer joined it. Test data prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Explorer qa-exp accumulates horizon_points across runs (already 150+ after review approvals). Use /leaderboard entries where is_me=true to assert relative changes rather than exact values. Copilot response cannot be asserted verbatim; assert length>15 and no verbatim greeting. Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. One minor UX callout: result dialog + toast can show '+0 Horizon Points' when re-mastering an already-mastered quest. Root cause: server returns delta (max(delta,0)) so 0 is correct; UI could hide the 0 or say 'Mastery preserved'.
